### system
Solve this CVRP instance. Node 0 is the depot; every other node is a customer. Minimize the total Euclidean distance traveled by all vehicles; use as many vehicles as needed. All numbers are integers: coordinates and times are scaled by 1000, demands are in units of capacity/1000.

Rules:
- Visit every customer exactly once.
- Routes start at the depot and return to it.
- The total demand on a route must not exceed the capacity.

Reply with only this JSON: {"routes": [[customer ids of route 1 in order], [route 2], ...]}. Do not write the depot.
